NASB.1: Then Moses assembled all the congregation of the sons of Israel, and said to them, 'These are the things that the LORD has commanded [you] to do:
NASB.2: 'For six days work may be done, but on the seventh day you shall have a holy [day], a sabbath of complete rest to the LORD; whoever does any work on it shall be put to death.
NASB.3: 'You shall not kindle a fire in any of your dwellings on the sabbath day.'
NASB.4: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, saying, 'This is the thing which the LORD has commanded, saying,
NASB.5: 'Take from among you a contribution to the LORD; whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it as the LORD'S contribution: gold, silver, and bronze,
NASB.6: and blue, purple and scarlet [material], fine linen, goats' [hair],
NASB.7: and rams' skins dyed red, and porpoise skins, and acacia wood,
NASB.8: and oil for lighting, and spices for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense,
NASB.9: and onyx stones and setting stones for the ephod and for the breastpiece.
NASB.10: 'Let every skillful man among you come, and make all that the LORD has commanded:
NASB.11: the tabernacle, its tent and its covering, its hooks and its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;
NASB.12: the ark and its poles, the mercy seat, and the curtain of the screen;
NASB.13: the table and its poles, and all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;
NASB.14: the lampstand also for the light and its utensils and its lamps and the oil for the light;
NASB.15: and the altar of incense and its poles, and the anointing oil and the fragrant incense, and the screen for the doorway at the entrance of the tabernacle;
NASB.16: the altar of burnt offering with its bronze grating, its poles, and all its utensils, the basin and its stand;
NASB.17: the hangings of the court, its pillars and its sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;
NASB.18: the pegs of the tabernacle and the pegs of the court and their cords;
NASB.19: the woven garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons, to minister as priests.''
NASB.20: Then all the congregation of the sons of Israel departed from Moses' presence.
NASB.21: Everyone whose heart stirred him and everyone whose spirit moved him came [and] brought the LORD'S contribution for the work of the tent of meeting and for all its service and for the holy garments.
NASB.22: Then all whose hearts moved them, both men and women, came [and] brought brooches and earrings and signet rings and bracelets, all articles of gold; so [did] every man who presented an offering of gold to the LORD.
NASB.23: Every man, who had in his possession blue and purple and scarlet [material] and fine linen and goats' [hair] and rams' skins dyed red and porpoise skins, brought them.
NASB.24: Everyone who could make a contribution of silver and bronze brought the LORD'S contribution; and every man who had in his possession acacia wood for any work of the service brought it.
NASB.25: All the skilled women spun with their hands, and brought what they had spun, [in] blue and purple [and] scarlet [material] and [in] fine linen.
NASB.26: All the women whose heart stirred with a skill spun the goats' [hair].
NASB.27: The rulers brought the onyx stones and the stones for setting for the ephod and for the breastpiece;
NASB.28: and the spice and the oil for the light and for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense.
NASB.29: The Israelites, all the men and women, whose heart moved them to bring [material] for all the work, which the LORD had commanded through Moses to be done, brought a freewill offering to the LORD.
NASB.30: Then Moses said to the sons of Israel, 'See, the LORD has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
NASB.31: 'And He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding and in knowledge and in all craftsmanship;
NASB.32: to make designs for working in gold and in silver and in bronze,
NASB.33: and in the cutting of stones for settings and in the carving of wood, so as to perform in every inventive work.
NASB.34: 'He also has put in his heart to teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
NASB.35: 'He has filled them with skill to perform every work of an engraver and of a designer and of an embroiderer, in blue and in purple [and] in scarlet [material], and in fine linen, and of a weaver, as performers of every work and makers of designs.

ESV.1: Moses assembled all the congregation of the people of Israel and said to them, “These are the things that the LORD has commanded you to do.
ESV.2: Six days work shall be done, but on the seventh day you shall have a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on it shall be put to death.
ESV.3: You shall kindle no fire in all your dwelling places on the Sabbath day.”
ESV.4: Moses said to all the congregation of the people of Israel, “This is the thing that the LORD has commanded.
ESV.5: Take from among you a contribution to the LORD. Whoever is of a generous heart, let him bring the LORD's contribution: gold, silver, and bronze;
ESV.6: blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen; goats' hair,
ESV.7: tanned rams' skins, and goatskins;  acacia wood,
ESV.8: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense,
ESV.9: and onyx stones and stones for setting, for the ephod and for the breastpiece.
ESV.10: “Let every skillful craftsman among you come and make all that the LORD has commanded:
ESV.11: the tabernacle, its tent and its covering, its hooks and its frames, its bars, its pillars, and its bases;
ESV.12: the ark with its poles, the mercy seat, and the veil of the screen;
ESV.13: the table with its poles and all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;
ESV.14: the lampstand also for the light, with its utensils and its lamps, and the oil for the light;
ESV.15: and the altar of incense, with its poles, and the anointing oil and the fragrant incense, and the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;
ESV.16: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its utensils, the basin and its stand;
ESV.17: the hangings of the court, its pillars and its bases, and the screen for the gate of the court;
ESV.18: the pegs of the tabernacle and the pegs of the court, and their cords;
ESV.19: the finely worked garments for ministering  in the Holy Place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, for their service as priests.”
ESV.20: Then all the congregation of the people of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
ESV.21: And they came, everyone whose heart stirred him, and everyone whose spirit moved him, and brought the LORD's contribution to be used for the tent of meeting, and for all its service, and for the holy garments.
ESV.22: So they came, both men and women. All who were of a willing heart brought brooches and earrings and signet rings and armlets, all sorts of gold objects, every man dedicating an offering of gold to the LORD.
ESV.23: And every one who possessed blue or purple or scarlet yarns or fine linen or goats' hair or tanned rams' skins or goatskins brought them.
ESV.24: Everyone who could make a contribution of silver or bronze brought it as the LORD's contribution. And every one who possessed acacia wood of any use in the work brought it.
ESV.25: And every skillful woman spun with her hands, and they all brought what they had spun in blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen.
ESV.26: All the women whose hearts stirred them to use their skill spun the goats' hair.
ESV.27: And the leaders brought onyx stones and stones to be set, for the ephod and for the breastpiece,
ESV.28: and spices and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense.
ESV.29: All the men and women, the people of Israel, whose heart moved them to bring anything for the work that the LORD had commanded by Moses to be done brought it as a freewill offering to the LORD.
ESV.30: Then Moses said to the people of Israel, “See, the LORD has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
ESV.31: and he has filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, with intelligence, with knowledge, and with all craftsmanship,
ESV.32: to devise artistic designs, to work in gold and silver and bronze,
ESV.33: in cutting stones for setting, and in carving wood, for work in every skilled craft.
ESV.34: And he has inspired him to teach, both him and Oholiab the son of Ahisamach of the tribe of Dan.
ESV.35: He has filled them with skill to do every sort of work done by an engraver or by a designer or by an embroiderer in blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen, or by a weaver — by any sort of workman or skilled designer.

NKJV.1: Then Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said to them, “These are the words which the LORD has commanded you to do:
NKJV.2: Work shall be done for six days, but the seventh day shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of rest to the LORD. Whoever does any work on it shall be put to death.
NKJV.3: You shall kindle no fire throughout your dwellings on the Sabbath day.”
NKJV.4: And Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying:
NKJV.5: ‘Take from among you an offering to the LORD. Whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it as an offering to the LORD: gold, silver, and bronze;
NKJV.6: blue, purple, and scarlet thread, fine linen, and goats’ hair;
NKJV.7: ram skins dyed red, badger skins, and acacia wood;
NKJV.8: oil for the light, and spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense;
NKJV.9: onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod and in the breastplate.
NKJV.10: ‘All who are gifted artisans among you shall come and make all that the LORD has commanded:
NKJV.11: the tabernacle, its tent, its covering, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;
NKJV.12: the ark and its poles, with the mercy seat, and the veil of the covering;
NKJV.13: the table and its poles, all its utensils, and the showbread;
NKJV.14: also the lampstand for the light, its utensils, its lamps, and the oil for the light;
NKJV.15: the incense altar, its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, and the screen for the door at the entrance of the tabernacle;
NKJV.16: the altar of burnt offering with its bronze grating, its poles, all its utensils, and the laver and its base;
NKJV.17: the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;
NKJV.18: the pegs of the tabernacle, the pegs of the court, and their cords;
NKJV.19: the garments of ministry, for ministering in the holy place—the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons, to minister as priests.’ ”
NKJV.20: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
NKJV.21: Then everyone came whose heart was stirred, and everyone whose spirit was willing, and they brought the LORD’s offering for the work of the tabernacle of meeting, for all its service, and for the holy garments.
NKJV.22: They came, both men and women, as many as had a willing heart, and brought earrings and nose rings, rings and necklaces, all jewelry of gold, that is, every man who made an offering of gold to the LORD.
NKJV.23: And every man, with whom was found blue, purple, and scarlet thread, fine linen, and goats’ hair, red skins of rams, and badger skins, brought them.
NKJV.24: Everyone who offered an offering of silver or bronze brought the LORD’s offering. And everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it.
NKJV.25: All the women who were gifted artisans spun yarn with their hands, and brought what they had spun, of blue, purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.
NKJV.26: And all the women whose hearts stirred with wisdom spun yarn of goats’ hair.
NKJV.27: The rulers brought onyx stones, and the stones to be set in the ephod and in the breastplate,
NKJV.28: and spices and oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
NKJV.29: The children of Israel brought a freewill offering to the LORD, all the men and women whose hearts were willing to bring material for all kinds of work which the LORD, by the hand of Moses, had commanded to be done.
NKJV.30: And Moses said to the children of Israel, “See, the LORD has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
NKJV.31: and He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom and understanding, in knowledge and all manner of workmanship,
NKJV.32: to design artistic works, to work in gold and silver and bronze,
NKJV.33: in cutting jewels for setting, in carving wood, and to work in all manner of artistic workmanship.
NKJV.34: “And He has put in his heart the ability to teach, in him and Aholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
NKJV.35: He has filled them with skill to do all manner of work of the engraver and the designer and the tapestry maker, in blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and fine linen, and of the weaver—those who do every work and those who design artistic works.

NLT.1: Then Moses called together the whole community of Israel and told them, “These are the instructions the LORD has commanded you to follow.
NLT.2: You have six days each week for your ordinary work, but the seventh day must be a Sabbath day of complete rest, a holy day dedicated to the LORD. Anyone who works on that day must be put to death.
NLT.3: You must not even light a fire in any of your homes on the Sabbath.”
NLT.4: Then Moses said to the whole community of Israel, “This is what the LORD has commanded:
NLT.5: Take a sacred offering for the LORD. Let those with generous hearts present the following gifts to the LORD: gold, silver, and bronze;
NLT.6:
blue, purple, and scarlet thread;
fine linen and goat hair for cloth;
NLT.7:
tanned ram skins and fine goatskin leather;
acacia wood;
NLT.8:
olive oil for the lamps;
spices for the anointing oil and the fragrant incense;
NLT.9: onyx stones, and other gemstones to be set in the ephod and the priest’s chestpiece.
NLT.10: “Come, all of you who are gifted craftsmen. Construct everything that the LORD has commanded:
NLT.11: the Tabernacle and its sacred tent, its covering, clasps, frames, crossbars, posts, and bases;
NLT.12:
the Ark and its carrying poles;
the Ark’s cover — the place of atonement;
the inner curtain to shield the Ark;
NLT.13:
the table, its carrying poles, and all its utensils;
the Bread of the Presence;
NLT.14: for light, the lampstand, its accessories, the lamp cups, and the olive oil for lighting;
NLT.15:
the incense altar and its carrying poles;
the anointing oil and fragrant incense;
the curtain for the entrance of the Tabernacle;
NLT.16:
the altar of burnt offering;
the bronze grating of the altar and its carrying poles and utensils;
the washbasin with its stand;
NLT.17:
the curtains for the walls of the courtyard;
the posts and their bases;
the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard;
NLT.18: the tent pegs of the Tabernacle and courtyard and their ropes;

Materials for the Tabernacle
Moses said to the whole Israelite community, “This is what the Lord has commanded:
NIV.5: From what you have, take an offering for the Lord. Everyone who is willing is to bring to the Lord an offering of gold, silver and bronze;
NIV.6: blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen; goat hair;

NRSVCE.4: Moses said to all the congregation of the Israelites: This is the thing that the LORD has commanded:
NRSVCE.5: Take from among you an offering to the LORD; let whoever is of a generous heart bring the LORD’s offering: gold, silver, and bronze;
NRSVCE.6: blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and fine linen; goats’ hair,
NRSVCE.7: tanned rams’ skins, and fine leather; acacia wood,
NRSVCE.8: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense,
NRSVCE.9: and onyx stones and gems to be set in the ephod and the breastpiece.
NRSVCE.10: All who are skillful among you shall come and make all that the LORD has commanded: the tabernacle,
NRSVCE.11: its tent and its covering, its clasps and its frames, its bars, its pillars, and its bases;
NRSVCE.12: the ark with its poles, the mercy seat, and the curtain for the screen;
NRSVCE.13: the table with its poles and all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;
NRSVCE.14: the lampstand also for the light, with its utensils and its lamps, and the oil for the light;
NRSVCE.15: and the altar of incense, with its poles, and the anointing oil and the fragrant incense, and the screen for the entrance, the entrance of the tabernacle;
NRSVCE.16: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its utensils, the basin with its stand;
NRSVCE.17: the hangings of the court, its pillars and its bases, and the screen for the gate of the court;
NRSVCE.18: the pegs of the tabernacle and the pegs of the court, and their cords;
NRSVCE.19: the finely worked vestments for ministering in the holy place, the holy vestments for the priest Aaron, and the vestments of his sons, for their service as priests.
NRSVCE.20: Then all the congregation of the Israelites withdrew from the presence of Moses.
NRSVCE.21: And they came, everyone whose heart was stirred, and everyone whose spirit was willing, and brought the LORD’s offering to be used for the tent of meeting, and for all its service, and for the sacred vestments.
NRSVCE.22: So they came, both men and women; all who were of a willing heart brought brooches and earrings and signet rings and pendants, all sorts of gold objects, everyone bringing an offering of gold to the LORD.
NRSVCE.23: And everyone who possessed blue or purple or crimson yarn or fine linen or goats’ hair or tanned rams’ skins or fine leather, brought them.
NRSVCE.24: Everyone who could make an offering of silver or bronze brought it as the LORD’s offering; and everyone who possessed acacia wood of any use in the work, brought it.
NRSVCE.25: All the skillful women spun with their hands, and brought what they had spun in blue and purple and crimson yarns and fine linen;
NRSVCE.26: all the women whose hearts moved them to use their skill spun the goats’ hair.
NRSVCE.27: And the leaders brought onyx stones and gems to be set in the ephod and the breastpiece,
NRSVCE.28: and spices and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense.
NRSVCE.29: All the Israelite men and women whose hearts made them willing to bring anything for the work that the LORD had commanded by Moses to be done, brought it as a freewill offering to the LORD.
NRSVCE.30: Then Moses said to the Israelites: See, the LORD has called by name Bezalel son of Uri son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
NRSVCE.31: he has filled him with divine spirit, with skill, intelligence, and knowledge in every kind of craft,
NRSVCE.32: to devise artistic designs, to work in gold, silver, and bronze,
NRSVCE.33: in cutting stones for setting, and in carving wood, in every kind of craft.
NRSVCE.34: And he has inspired him to teach, both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
NRSVCE.35: He has filled them with skill to do every kind of work done by an artisan or by a designer or by an embroiderer in blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and in fine linen, or by a weaver — by any sort of artisan or skilled designer.
